# Duetsheet

> Duetsheet (the sheet humans and AI agents play from together, record every move on, and rerun) is an open-source, single-file interactive HTML report that humans and AI agents review and revise together. Users edit text and charts in place, leave per-block comments, and draw box or lasso annotations on charts and images; chart annotations are stored as data-space ranges plus the ids of the enclosed data points. Every edit is recorded with before/after values and its author (human or AI), grouped into review rounds shown on a timeline. The report is plain JSON (report.json) with a published JSON Schema, so any LLM agent can read the feedback and revise the report.

Version 0.5. Start it from Claude Code with the /duetsheet skill (install: `/plugin marketplace add Ashur5457/duetsheet`, then `/plugin install duetsheet@duetsheet`), or run `python duetsheet.py <data folder>` (Python standard library only): the report opens in the browser already connected to the folder, and is stored in its duetsheet/ subfolder while raw data is only read. It also runs with no install at all (open duetsheet.html in Chrome or Edge and choose a folder), as a Claude Artifact, or with saved report files in any browser. Problems the page meets are listed under a warning button and, with the launcher, printed for the agent and saved in errors.log; `python duetsheet.py check <folder>` validates report.json. Datasets imported from data/ record their source path and SHA-256, and the page flags data that changed after import. Each figure keeps its source (tool, script, raw data). The figure style profile can be learned from the user's own SVG figures and .mplstyle files, exported to matplotlib, and suggested by agents for the user to confirm. The interface is available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Spanish, and users can load their own translations.

Use Duetsheet when an AI agent drafts a data-heavy report (science, finance, engineering, research) and a human expert must check and correct it precisely. Works with Claude Code, Claude on claude.ai, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor or any agent that can edit JSON files.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is, features, quick start (local folder and Claude), FAQ, limitations, roadmap
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): data model, how to write report.json safely, and agent tasks (revise from annotations, import raw data with provenance, learn figure habits, write a new report)
- [Tutorial](docs/tutorial.md): step by step with screenshots
- [JSON Schema](schema/report.schema.json): formal definition of report.json
- [Translating](docs/translating.md): how interface translations work and how to add a language

## Files

- [duetsheet.html](duetsheet.html): the viewer and editor (single self-contained file)
- [duetsheet.py](duetsheet.py): launcher and checker (`python duetsheet.py <folder>`, `check <folder>`, `install-skill`, `shortcut <folder>` for a desktop shortcut, `init-agent <folder>` to point any agent that reads AGENTS.md to Duetsheet)
- [skills/duetsheet/SKILL.md](skills/duetsheet/SKILL.md): the /duetsheet skill for Claude Code
- [Example project](examples/demo-project/): report.json, data/ and habits/ for a demo report (synthetic data)
- [tools/check.py](tools/check.py): checks translations and English-only code before a commit

- [Screenshots](docs/): view mode, figure annotation, Folder tab, change log and timeline, style suggestions
